column1: # Engine wave W5 (18 Oct 2026, rulings R136–R138): the regional safe default for Africa south of the Sahara
# (`default.safe.africa`, Generic.kt; spec §6.2 c), gated for the first time. Two kinds of row:
# 1. REAL ROWS — Tanzania. The country (228 app cities) is routed to this region (Registry.kt), and Darul
#    Ihsan's 2026 tables for Dar es Salaam and Zanzibar are the only timetables held for it (the research:
#    "The Darul Ihsan perpetual table covers Dar es Salaam and Zanzibar with the South African rules; who uses
#    it is unknown. LOW."). Each at the app's own city point (cities.csv; Darul Ihsan prints no point): the
#    Hanafi file's every column (its Fajr is also checked as the end of eating, F+E: no sehri column is printed),
#    the Shafi'i file's Asr and Isha (its other columns repeat the Hanafi file's). 0 early, 0 late ends; what the
#    region costs there is recorded as the entry's late limits (Generic.kt, africaLateLimits) and in BUILD-LOG:
#    Fajr 15 to 18 min after the 18° dawn Darul Ihsan prints (this region's Fajr is the 15° in use at Abuja and
#    Dakar, the latest on the continent), the end of eating 7 to 10 min before that Fajr (the 19.5° dawn − 2 min),
#    Isha 14 to 18 min after the Shafi'i 15° column and up to 5 after the Hanafi 18°, sunrise up to 6 min before,
#    Dhuhr and Maghrib up to 5 after, Asr up to 4 (the floors plus the cushion). Whether Tanzania should have its
#    own 18° entry is the owner's question (BUILD-LOG, W5).
# 2. STRESS ROWS — South Africa, which has its own entry (za.jamiat) and is never routed here: Jamiat's 2026
#    tables for its eight research towns (round/data-wide-band/jamiat-7g, with the printed Suhoor column E, both
#    Asr columns and the Hanafi Isha; the Shafi'i Isha column is not held in these files) at Jamiat's own printed
#    points (JamiatTowns.kt), and Darul Ihsan's Pretoria and Durban Hanafi tables. The same system as Tanzania's
#    tables, so the same costs, a little larger at the Cape's latitude (Fajr up to 24 min). Nothing is masked.
# Every row is held out: no margin of this region was fitted on any of these tables (its figures are the spec's).
# Côte d'Ivoire was routed here until the safe defaults lane (12 Nov 2026) found this region early against COSIM's tables
# at Abidjan (Dhuhr 49 to 50 min and Asr 37 min before its conventional 13:00 and 16:00, the end of eating after its
# 1436 imsak): the country has its own entry since, ci.default, and its rows are gate/ci-default.tsv.
